name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Central Sector scheme providing income support of ₹6,000 per year to all landholding farmer families across the country.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year paid in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly transferred to Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts every four months.
required_documents: Land Ownership Document (Record of Rights / 7/12 / Khatauni / Patta)
Active Mobile Number linked to Aadhaar
application_steps: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (https://pmkisan.gov.in) and select 'New Farmer Registration' under Farmers Corner.
Enter your Aadhaar number and registered mobile number, then verify via OTP.
Select your State, District, Sub-District, Block, and Village from the dropdowns.
Enter personal details, bank account details, and land parcel survey / khasra numbers.
Upload land ownership documents and submit the application for state verification.
department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Comprehensive yield-based crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against non-preventable natural risks, crop damage, pests, and unseasonal weather.
benefits: Full sum insured payout against natural perils (drought, flood, unseasonal rains, pest attacks) with minimal farmer premium: 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops.
required_documents: Sowing Certificate / Crop Sowing Declaration (issued by Patwari / Village Officer)
Land Record Document (RoR / 7/12 / RTC) or Valid Tenancy Agreement
Kisan Credit Card (KCC) account details if availed
application_steps: Visit the official PMFBY National Crop Insurance Portal (https://pmfby.gov.in).
Click 'Farmer Corner' and sign in using your mobile number or create a new user account.
Select Scheme, Season (Kharif/Rabi), Year, State, and Insured Crop.
Provide land survey number and crop sowing area in acres/hectares.
Upload sowing certificate and land ownership or tenancy proof.
Pay the subsidized farmer premium online or complete enrollment at the nearest CSC center / Bank branch.
department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare

name: PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop (Micro Irrigation)
description: Centrally sponsored scheme promoting precision water management through Drip and Sprinkler irrigation systems with substantial capital subsidy.
benefits: Up to 55% financial subsidy for Small and Marginal farmers (holding up to 5 acres / 2 hectares) and up to 45% subsidy for other farmers on the benchmark cost of drip and sprinkler irrigation installations.
required_documents: Updated Land Record (7/12 extract / Khatauni / RTC)
Proof of Assured Water Source (Borewell / Open Well / Canal / Farm Pond electricity connection bill)
Soil and Water Quality Testing Certificate
Quotation / Design layout from empaneled micro-irrigation manufacturer
application_steps: Register on your State Horticulture / Agriculture Department DBT Portal or PMKSY portal.
Submit farmer identity details, land survey number, and crop cultivation plan.
Choose an empaneled micro-irrigation equipment manufacturer and obtain system design.
Submit the application for administrative approval and field verification by Assistant Director of Horticulture/Agriculture.
Post-installation GPS verification is conducted, and subsidy is directly credited to bank account via DBT.
department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / State Horticulture Departments

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
description: Institutional short-term crop loan and working capital credit facility at highly concessional interest rates for agricultural and allied activities.
benefits: Short-term agricultural credit up to ₹3,00,000 at an effective subsidized interest rate of 4% per annum (with 3% prompt repayment incentive). Collateral-free credit limit up to ₹1,60,000.
required_documents: Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card / Voter ID / PAN Card)
Land Record Details (Khatauni / 7/12 / RTC) or Crop Tenancy Certificate
Cropping pattern and cultivated acreage details
application_steps: Download the standard one-page KCC loan application form from the Ministry of Agriculture portal or visit your nearest Bank branch / CSC.
Fill out farmer personal information, operational landholding details, and proposed crop cultivation.
Attach copies of Aadhaar, land records, and crop details.
Submit the application to any Commercial Bank, Regional Rural Bank (RRB), or Cooperative Bank.
The bank inspects and issues the KCC Smart Card / RuPay Kisan Card within 14 working days.
department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Finance, RBI & NABARD

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
description: Financial subsidy assistance for procurement of modern agricultural machinery, power tillers, tractors, rotavators, and custom hiring centers.
benefits: 40% to 50% capital subsidy (up to 50% for Small, Marginal, SC/ST, and Women farmers; 40% for other farmers) on individual farm implements, power tillers, reapers, seed drills, and up to 80% subsidy for village Custom Hiring Centers.
required_documents: Proforma Invoice from authorized farm equipment dealer
application_steps: Register on the official Farmech Portal (https://agrimachinery.nic.in).
Select 'Farmer Registration' and enter Aadhaar details, farmer category, and district.
Select the desired agricultural implement / machine and approved manufacturer/dealer.
Upload land record document, bank passbook copy, and photo.
Upon administrative sanction, procure the equipment and upload the purchase invoice for DBT subsidy credit.
department: Mechanization & Technology Division, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Nationwide soil testing scheme providing periodic farm-level soil nutrient status reports and tailored fertilizer & micronutrient recommendations.
benefits: Free comprehensive soil health test report evaluating 12 key soil parameters (Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium, Sulphur, Zinc, Iron, Copper, Manganese, Boron, pH, Electrical Conductivity, and Organic Carbon) along with crop-specific fertilizer dosage guidance.
required_documents: Current cropping history and next planned crop details
application_steps: Contact your local Gram Panchayat Agriculture Extension Officer (Kisan Mitra / Gram Sevak) or visit the nearest Soil Testing Laboratory.
Provide your land survey details for GPS-referenced soil sampling from your farm field.
Soil samples are analyzed at authorized district/block soil testing laboratories.
Download or collect your printed Soil Health Card with tailored nutrient recommendations from https://soilhealth.dac.gov.in.
department: Integrated Nutrient Management Division, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
